authority: spec section 3 + implementation plan section 3 register (q decision, resolved)

q_decision.chosen: FRONT-SET COMPOSITING: T at a sigma point = product of (1 - alpha_i * G_i(pixel)) over Gaussians strictly in front along the pixel ray, query-track source excluded, candidate family counterfactually present; exact w.r.t. the rasterizer's compositing model; NO CUDA change
q_decision.selection_criteria_applied: closed-form 2-3-Gaussian fixture (tests/test_elgs_observability.py, 1e-15); accuracy (exact); query-source exclusion (verified on the fixture); gradient isolation (probe runs under no_grad, q is a frozen round snapshot); runtime/memory cost (spatially pruned per-query gather, profiled at S1 - see compute_estimate)
rejected_alternatives: depth-thresholded front-subset alpha renders: an approximation with disclosed quantization that the exact option makes unnecessary

CUDA rasterizer addition returning depth-truncated T: not required while (a) meets the runtime budget; revisited only if S1 profiling fails it, then as a narrow reviewed change with reference-parity tests
q_decision.reference_parity: the GPU implementation must match elgs.probe.AnalyticProbe on the closed-form fixture to 1e-6
q_decision.approximation_limitation: exactness is w.r.t. the compositing model (Gaussian footprint at the pixel center); sub-pixel footprint integration is not modeled - disclosed
q_decision.compute_estimate: per (bridge, track, camera, frame): sigma_points x pruned-gather; per-round budget bounded by C_cap x |tracks| x |frames in windows| x n_sigma; measured at S1 and entered into the census-cell projections

sigma_points.scheme: deterministic 7-point grid: bridge point center (weight 0.4) + 6 axis offsets at +/- one bridge-covariance sigma per world axis (weight 0.1 each); nonnegative, sums to one; no negative-weight unscented transform

kappa_res.definition: clipped area ratio: (projected footprint area within the image) / (full projected footprint area), clipped to [0,1]

rho.criterion: match the empirical variance inflation of per-camera report agreement

q_source_update_matrix_arms.note: the decisive B3 contrasts (claim C2); definitions per the experiment plan; frozen here to prevent drift

snapshot.rule: q is a round snapshot: written at round boundaries, frozen for the round (QSnapshot: double-write, post-freeze write, and missing-key reads raise); candidates scored under the snapshot with counterfactual insertion
